You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

entry = rlm.harness.create_memory(title='ARC: open-top 5 frames fill with 2 and spill outward', path='arc', global_=True, content='''Task pattern: A zero-background grid can contain one or more hollow rectangular frames made of color 5. Each frame has a single missing cell in the top edge (an opening). Recolor the entire interior cavity and the missing top-edge cell to color 2. Also draw a horizontal ray of 2s on the row immediately above the frame, beginning at the opening and running to the grid edge on the side opposite the opening’s horizontal displacement from the frame center: opening right-of-center => ray left; opening left-of-center => ray right. Preserve existing 5s and all unrelated cells. Apply independently to each frame.

Evidence: Demo A frame rows 4–7, cols 3–6; top opening at col 5 (right of bbox midpoint 4.5), interior 2x2. Output filled opening and interior with 2, plus ray left on row 3 from col 5 through grid col 1. Demo B frame rows 4–8, cols 4–7; top opening col 5 (left of midpoint 5.5), interior 3x2. Output filled opening and interior, plus ray right on row 3 from col 5 to grid col 10. Test contained two frames, both with opening in right half, and each got leftward ray.

Implementation: Find each axis-aligned frame’s bbox and top-edge gap; set all zero cavity cells enclosed by frame rows/cols to 2, set top gap to 2, and lay the corresponding horizontal ray one row above. Preserve the original 5 border. The examples establish off-center opening direction; behavior for a perfectly centered opening is not demonstrated.''')
(entry.id,entry.title,entry.scope)
